page.overview:
Who is Bartigula?

Bartigula was a character in I, Carumbus.

Bartigula was born to Obeseus the Wide and Majora in Ancient Rome. He grew up rich and spoiled, turning him in to a slaveowner to Ptolemaic Book Guy from a young age. When Emperor Burns died by being crushed by a pillar and brain eaten by lions, he became emperor of Rome. After that, he made foolish decisions including declaring war on Neptune, God of the Sea, building a large and expensive wall to protect Rome from the invaders, and dissolving the entire Roman Senate in acid. When Obeseus tried to stop his reckless actions, Bartigula declared to feed him to the lions, but by the time he was so fat that they needed more lions and locked him up instead.

When Obeseus was bailed out by Lisandra, Bartigula fought him in a battle to the death. He successfully stabbed Obeseus in the throat, but he was strangled to death by him.

He is the parody character of Caligula. Category:Characters
